title: CIA-UAP-013, Report of Unusual Flying Object Sightings and Attendant Scientific Activity
doc_notes: This is a CIA Information Report containing a translated excerpt from a personal letter describing UAP sightings in Budapest, Hungary, in November 1955.

incidents.summary: Multiple fast-speed flying objects observed over Budapest, Hungary, reported by a civilian source.
incidents.quote: These very fast speeding flyers at scientific activity - very busy.
